pages.title: Morrow Creek — Visitor Information
pages.body: Morrow Creek welcomes you. The falls lookout trail remains closed for maintenance. Fall Market is October 25. Please call the town office for hours.

pages.title: Late Eats — Morrow Creek Diner
pages.body: The coffee is decent. Sit by the window when it rains. If June is working, ask what happened to the old jukebox.

pages.title: Local Shows: October 2003
pages.body: Friday acoustic night is postponed. Bring your own chords next time. Please stop leaving flyers on the telephone pole by the diner.
